title: Silver Springs Survival PvP Event! (Jan. 2019)
description:
What's up guys, MrJoned here with another Minecraft Tutorial Vid-- oh.. wait.. Sorry, this was a PvP event! Every single fight from today's PvP event in chronological order! I'll put some timestamps down below ;)

For those curious, this is on the Silver Springs Minecraft Server -- IP: SSSminecraft.com

Be on the lookout for more events every weekend!
